```sql
SELECT DISTINCT p."ID", p."Birthday", p."Diagnosis"
FROM main."Patient" p
JOIN main."Laboratory" l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."GOT" >= 60
  AND l."Date" >= '1997-01-01'
  AND l."Date" < '1998-01-01'
  AND l."Date" < '1998-06-01'
```
